data_fields.name: cast_factor_fallback
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 ms for casts of 1000 ms or less; else cast time in ms

best_idea: Resolve one hit as an ordered cascade of named results (immune, stored miss, front-only dodge, block, parry, accuracy, then crit) and reduce damage by one armour curve, armour / (armour + 5300), returning value and absorbed so the client can show both.
decision_why: The ordered cascade and the armour curve are clean, testable and server-side, so take their shape for one duel-step resolver; but the donor's stat names, cast-time-times-dps base and integer divisions are quirks not to copy, and guard, stamina and hit impact belong to rows 3 and 10.
acceptance: A server test with a scripted random source: a front-facing defender that rolls dodge, block and parry returns exactly one of them in that order; accuracy 100 never misses; armour 1000 on a 100-damage hit gives value 84 and absorbed 15; a melee crit multiplies before the armour curve.
